patch.value: Cover pm-changelog cli.ts and extension.ts to reach the 100/100/100 aggregate

The scripts blind spot is closed and six of eight measured files are at 100/100/100, but two remain and hold the aggregate at 93.72 / 92.40 / 93.82.

src/cli.ts   88.69 lines / 59.56 branches / 80.65 functions
  uncovered: 260-261 386-387 389-390 401-402 419-420 425-426 428-429 438-439 456-457 462-463 465-466 468-469 474-475 477-478 480-481 483-484 486-487 489-490 492-493 495-496 571-572 604-620 643-644 662-672 674-677 681 686-692 695-701 704-710 712-715 850-851 869-870 880-881 890-891
src/extension.ts   62.39 lines / 38.98 branches / 47.37 functions
  uncovered: 44-54 57-59 129-130 132-133 136-137 176-181 186-188 190-195 230-251 253-293 295-303 356-362 366-372 376-377 396-413 442-479 494-495 511-519 524-532 544-546 553-561
src/generator.ts is at 99.84 branches, one branch short of 100.

Approach that worked for the scripts and should be reused: export the logic and guard the CLI entry with a direct-execution check, then import in-process. Coverage is only attributed to files loaded in the same process, so a test that spawns the CLI as a subprocess adds nothing and the gate correctly reports the file as never loaded. If any child process is spawned by a test, pass NODE_V8_COVERAGE set to empty string in the child env or the child writes coverage into the parent's directory and corrupts lcov.

A partially written test/cli-coverage.test.ts from the abandoned first attempt is parked outside the repo. Do not restore it blindly: it hung indefinitely under node --test with --test-timeout=0 and its orphaned child contaminated a measurement run. Treat it as a reference for which cases were planned, not as working code.

Raise thresholds to 100/100/100 only once measured. Do not reach the number by lowering a threshold, adding a coverage ignore, or adding a c8/istanbul/v8 ignore comment.

npm run coverage reports 100 lines, 100 branches and 100 functions with all 8 files present in the measured set; coverageGate.thresholds is 100/100/100; no coverage ignore comments and no additions to coverageGate.ignore; npm run docstring still reports the documented surface complete.
